principles: Feature work dominates. Foundational work earns its place by unblocking the feature in focus, and says which one in its goal.
One focus at a time. A feature is not done when it compiles, it is done when it is playtestable and has an audit report the user can act on.

The user's mocks are the design floor. They are ideas to build on, which means a runner may go further than a mock, never below it or away from it: its look, layout, controls, copy length and interactions are what ships. A departure is a decision card, never a quiet rewrite, and a mock page is never edited to match the code.
Delight and ease are acceptance criteria, not aspirations. If a feature works but feels clumsy, it is not done.
Only epics staged now may hold open tasks. Anything serving a later epic waits, so we ship something finished instead of everything half-built.

Ask the grown-up-tool question every time: would someone who knows Premiere (for video) or Photoshop (for pictures) find this where they expect it, and is it easier here? Actions live where you click: a right-click menu on the thing, not a tool or a panel button for everything.
A feature exists only if a person running Next with default settings can reach it. A walk that forces a flag proves nothing about what the user sees.

children.title: Audio you can see and shape
success: A recording's own sound is visible under its picture as an audio segment with a waveform, from the moment it opens
Detach, move, trim, fade, and set the volume of any audio segment; bring in music on its own track

children.title: Fast, predictable export and share
success: Export MP4, GIF, HEIC and a single frame through the one Export sheet, with size shown before exporting

A Premiere or Final Cut editor can cut a 5 minute screen recording to 90 seconds, add a second clip and a music bed, a title that flies in, captions, a transition, and export MP4, without being taught, in less time than in Premiere
The timeline, transport, clips, tracks, transition picker and properties match the video mocks (video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html) side by side
Playback of a full-screen Retina recording never blinks or stutters
Everything is reachable in Next with default settings
